description: Works out how much fabric to buy before washing so that the usable length needed remains afterwards: required length = (usable length + extra) ÷ (1 − lengthwise shrinkage), then rounded up to the shop’s selling increment. Works in metres or yards (any one unit). A negative shrinkage rate means growth.

extra_length.description: Optional extra usable length after washing (default 0). Do not count an allowance the pattern already includes.

shop_increment.description: The shop’s selling increment to round up to, e.g. 0.25 for quarter metres or 0.125 for eighth yards. 0 for no rounding (default 0).

shrinkage_percent.description: Measured lengthwise shrinkage in percent, e.g. 5 for 5%. Negative means growth.

unit.description: Unit of the lengths (only used to label the answer). Default m.

usable_length.description: Length needed after washing (check the pattern layout), greater than 0.

name: plan_fabric_length
title: Plan fabric length to buy
